title: Rethinking AI Evaluation through TEACH-AI: A Human-Centered Benchmark and Toolkit for Evaluating AI Assistants in Education

bias_targets.methodology: The paper proposes a conceptual benchmark framework (TEACH-AI) that incorporates 'Responsibility & Ethics' as a core component. It proposes evaluating this through group fairness metrics, fairness stress tests, adversarial prompt handling, and qualitative checklist prompts asking if the agent supports diverse users equitably.

The framework includes 'Accessibility' as a specific evaluation component to measure equitable access for humans with diverse physical and cognitive abilities. Proposed methodologies include tracking text-to-audio adaptation rates, assistive technology integration, and assessing multi-modal UX compatibility.
